info.title: API.SH: Baseball Reference
info.description: The Baseball Reference API from API.SH: public Baseball Reference data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An award's winners by year: MVP and Cy Young, Rookie of the Year, Gold Gloves and Silver Sluggers by league, Manager of the Year, Hall of Fame. Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/baseball-reference-awards

parameters.name: tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated table ids to return (see `table_ids` in any answer), e.g. `per_game_stats,advanced`; default every table on the page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/baseball-reference-boxscore

get.description:
A season's batting or pitching leaderboards: `leaderboards`, one per category (WAR, average, home runs, ERA, strikeouts...), each with `id`, `title` and `rows` (`rank`, `name`, `url`, `team`, `value`).

get.description:
Any other page of baseball-reference.com (managers, franchises, ballparks, postseason, minor leagues, Negro Leagues, splits, umpires...), read the same way: `bio` where the page has a header block, `scorebox` on box scores, `games` on score pages, and every table. Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/baseball-reference-page

parameters.name: tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated table ids to return (see `table_ids` in any answer), e.g. `per_game_stats,advanced`; default every table on the page.

get.summary: Baseball Reference player page: bio and every stats table
get.description:
One player's page: `bio` (`name`, `image`, `birth_date`, `facts` such as position, height, weight, team, born, college, draft and debut, every bio `lines`, `social` links and `achievements`), `schema` (the page's structured person data) and every table on the page (standard, value and advanced batting and pitching, postseason, fielding, appearances by position, projections, salaries). Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/baseball-reference-player

parameters.description: Player id (`ohtansh01`) or a link to the player page.

parameters.name: tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated table ids to return (see `table_ids` in any answer), e.g. `per_game_stats,advanced`; default every table on the page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Baseball Reference season schedule and results
get.description:
The whole regular season by day: `days` (`date`, `count`, `games` with `away` and `home` team, `score`, `time` for games not played yet, `boxscore_url`, and the line as text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/baseball-reference-schedule

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Baseball Reference scores for a date
get.description:
Every game played on a date: `games` (`teams` with `name`, `url`, `score` and `winner`, `status`, `boxscore_url`), plus the division standings before and after the day. An empty `games` means no games that day.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/baseball-reference-scores

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Baseball Reference by name: players, teams, coaches and other pages, grouped in `sections` (`section`, `label`, `count`, `items` with `name`, `years` active, `url`, `id`, `team`, `league`, `note` such as nicknames, `badges`). When the name has one exact match the site jumps to, `sections` holds that one page (`section` `exact`). Use `id` with the player routes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/baseball-reference-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name or text to search for.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
